name: applebot
description: Apple's search crawler, which powers Spotlight, Siri and Safari suggestions. It classifies as a crawler, like Googlebot, so the gateway always serves it canonical HTML. User-Agent strings are transcribed from Apple's published documentation (https://support.apple.com/en-us/119829, fetched 2026-09-28), not captured from our own traffic; the other headers are illustrative. Applebot-Extended has no sample on purpose: Apple documents it as a robots.txt token that does not crawl, so it never arrives as a User-Agent. It only decides whether Applebot's crawl may train Apple's models.
